initiative.title: Independent security and resilience verification
initiative.summary: Adversarial verification with evidence-backed fixes, independent retests and durable regressions.

taskset.summary: A reusable role and bounded verification evidence contract; consumer findings remain host-owned.

tasks.title: Add independent security and resilience reviewer with evidence closure
tasks.goal: Make independent security and stability verification dispatchable and prevent unverified closure.
tasks.summary: Owner requests a reusable independent adversarial role covering authorization bypass, request replay and failure recovery; retain existing lifecycle and security-service boundaries.
tasks.scope: Add a dispatchable security-reviewer role and a read-only evidence validator. Require exact source revision, independent reviewer, all three test families, and reproduction/fix/retest/regression links. Do not run scans, change host policies, install into consumers, send notifications or merge.

units.title: Add independent security and resilience reviewer with evidence closure
units.context: Owner requests a reusable independent adversarial role covering authorization bypass, request replay and failure recovery; retain existing lifecycle and security-service boundaries.
units.scope: Add a dispatchable security-reviewer role and a read-only evidence validator. Require exact source revision, independent reviewer, all three test families, and reproduction/fix/retest/regression links. Do not run scans, change host policies, install into consumers, send notifications or merge.
steps: Add the managed role skill and orchestrator alias.
Implement bounded read-only report validation with unknown and failure states.
Test evidence independence, missing coverage, fixed-finding closure, source binding and unsafe paths; verify generated-host inclusion.
acceptance: The generated host resolves security-reviewer and security/resilience aliases to the managed skill.
The validator blocks self-review and incomplete finding closure; absent coverage remains unknown.
The validator never executes a command or accesses a network target; evidence references remain within the declared evidence directory.
units.handoff: Return changed files, exact source version, test evidence, limitations, independent review and recovery instructions.
units.stop_condition: Stop before consumer installation, scans against live targets, permission changes, publishing a release or merging.
